touches.text: It is the only way devices talk to one another.
A message is addressed to a name (a device instance), never to a connection. A shim that restarts reconnects and answers to the same name, so restarting it never restarts the bus.

An instance is declared by its folder existing in class-space: cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/ (one address in two roots). Declared = the folders (read by the rack tool, 17.20); running = which of those are in the rack.
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.
system_word: case-folding for system words (device names, verbs, statuses). WHY: anything you type is case-insensitive. USERS: everyone that parses a command.
